novel_mechanic.name: Imbue
novel_mechanic.summary: 'Imbue your Hero Power' replaces the player's Hero Power with the class's Imbued Hero Power and increments a per-game imbue count; the Imbued HP's effect scales with how many times it has been imbued (the @ placeholders are level-dependent). Payoffs read the count ('If you've Imbued your Hero Power twice / 4 times').
engine_needs: player.imbues_this_game counter (per-game, never reset) + a per-HP imbue LEVEL on the hero power
Imbue(player) action: look up the class's Imbued HP token; on first imbue replace hero.power with it; on subsequent imbues bump its level; always bump imbues_this_game

Imbued HP effects scale by level — the @ values are level-dependent (e.g. Blessing of the Wisp: summon @ Wisps + deal @ damage; @ grows with level). Confirm exact scaling from data TAG_SCRIPT_DATA_NUM / level tags
classes without an Imbued HP (DK/DH/Rogue/Warlock/Warrior): only 6 HPs exist; decide no-op-but-count vs class-locked — confirm from data how neutral Imbue cards behave off-class
'Imbue your Hero Power, then trigger it' (EDR_519 Wisprider); 'Battlecry and Deathrattle: Imbue' (EDR_451); Start-of-Game imbue (EDR_845 Hamuul)
